text:
Situation: Ampicillin sodium is listed by FDA as To Be Discontinued. Corvale East holds 18 days on hand across presentations; Corvale General holds 20 days on hand. Sandoz Inc. posted a private label discontinuation on 2025-12-08. No other manufacturers appear on FDA's shortage list today.

Why (FDA record): The label for NDC 83270031110 names OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited - Beta Lactam Division (FEI 3005652193) as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 940034 of that plant ended 2015-09-01, classified OAI, classification known 2015-11-30. The most recent inspection, 1079813, ended 2019-02-14, classified VAI. An alternative label (NDC 83634010920) names ACS DOBFAR SPA as manufacturer with the link listed as sponsor only.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly three weeks. No alternative source is on FDA's shortage list. We must secure additional supply before stock falls below two weeks.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., Civica Inc., Eugia US LLC, Fresenius Kabi USA LLC, and HF Acquisition Co LLC DBA HealthFirst; P&T Committee to approve addition of these suppliers to formulary.
2. Buyer to request allocation data and lead times from each supplier; P&T Committee to review and approve preferred vendor ranking.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list daily for new postings; P&T Committee to receive weekly status updates until supply stabilizes.

Not recommended: Initiate therapeutic substitutions or protocol changes at this time; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
